senses.sense_definition: een geordende lijst of volgorde op basis van rang, belang of een ander kenmerk

examples.text: De landen staan in <w>rangorde</w> vermeld naar de bevolkingsgrootte, de grootste landen staan bovenaan.

target_lang_translations.en: The countries are listed in <w>order of precedence</w> according to population size, with the largest countries at the top.

examples.text: Tijdens de gymles stonden de kinderen in <w>rangorde</w> van hun lengte opgesteld.

target_lang_translations.en: During gym class, the children were lined up in <w>order</w> of their height.

target_lang_definitions.en: An ordered list or sequence based on rank, importance, or another characteristic.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: a position in a scale of achievement or status
the order in which people or things are ranked
a system in which members are ranked according to relative status
the arrangement or disposition of people or things

senses.sense_definition: een specifieke positie of plaats binnen een geordende reeks

examples.text: Zijn <w>rangorde</w> op de lijst van rijkste mensen is dit jaar flink gestegen.

target_lang_translations.en: His <w>ranking</w> on the list of richest people has risen significantly this year.

examples.text: De officier behield zijn hoge <w>rangorde</w> ondanks de recente veranderingen in de organisatie.

target_lang_translations.en: The officer maintained his high <w>rank</w> despite the recent changes in the organization.

target_lang_definitions.en: A specific position or place within an ordered series.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: a position within the hierarchy of an organization or society
a specific place on a list
a place where someone or something is located or has been put
